001.name: Santa
001.title: The Master Artisan
001.series: Series 1: Winter Legends & Iconic Holiday Characters
001.abilities: Winks with a subtle magical twinkle; cradles a glowing gold-leaf key that unlocks holiday cheer.
001.motto: Every heart has a spark of magic—share yours generously!
001.nfcMotif: A sculpted golden sleigh bell with concentric sonar waves.

002.name: Frosty
002.title: The Snowbound Joy
002.series: Series 1: Winter Legends & Iconic Holiday Characters
002.abilities: Balances a tiny red-breasted clay robin on his twig hand amidst swirling felt snowflakes.
002.motto: Stay cool, melt barriers, and always bring the sunshine with you!
002.nfcMotif: A glowing clay carrot nose medallion.

003.name: Rudolph
003.title: The Beacon of Light
003.series: Series 1: Winter Legends & Iconic Holiday Characters
003.abilities: Emits an atmospheric amber glow from his translucent ruby-red resin nose to light up snowy paths.
003.motto: Never dim your light—it is the very compass someone needs to find their way.
003.nfcMotif: A glowing ruby sphere icon labeled "TAP THE RED NOSE".

004.name: Jack Frost
004.title: The Frost Sprite
004.series: Series 1: Winter Legends & Iconic Holiday Characters
004.abilities: Blows miniature glowing fractal frost plumes across icy surfaces using a slender crystal wand.
004.motto: Winter’s chill only makes the fireside laughter that much sweeter.
004.nfcMotif: A carved six-point ice crystal badge.

005.name: Nutcracker
005.title: The Hearth Sentry
005.series: Series 1: Winter Legends & Iconic Holiday Characters
005.abilities: Stands at strict attention in polished lacquer armor, guarding the festive space beside a wrapped drum.
005.motto: Stand tall in purpose, guard what you cherish, and march toward joy!
005.nfcMotif: A royal golden crest with crossed drumsticks.

006.name: The Tree
006.title: The Evergreen Hearth
006.series: Series 1: Winter Legends & Iconic Holiday Characters
006.abilities: Casts volumetric downward light from an internal-glowing buttercream star through layered felt branches.
006.motto: Deeply rooted in love, reaching endlessly toward the light.

007.name: Snowflake
007.title: The Celestial Crystal
007.series: Series 1: Winter Legends & Iconic Holiday Characters
007.abilities: Radiates soft cyan bioluminescence from its opalescent resin core, floating weightlessly in twilight.
007.motto: Unique in every angle, fleeting in time, infinite in beauty.
007.nfcMotif: An intricate embossed hexagonal snowflake core.

008.name: Gift
008.title: The Surprise Box
008.series: Series 1: Winter Legends & Iconic Holiday Characters
008.abilities: Cracks open its lid to project a beam of warm golden light, magical ribbons, and star dust.
008.motto: The sweetest presents aren’t tied in ribbons, but wrapped in presence.
008.nfcMotif: The center knot of the cherry-red satin ribbon bow.

009.name: The Gingerbread Man
009.title: The Classic Runner
009.abilities: Sprints mid-stride across powdered sugar with bouncy energy and gumdrop button resilience.
009.motto: Run toward joy, embrace the adventure, and savor every sweet second!
009.nfcMotif: A scalloped frosted gingerbread cookie medallion labeled "TAP FOR SWEET CHEER".

010.name: Mrs. Claus
010.title: The North Pole Hearth
010.abilities: Radiates soothing kitchen warmth and supplies an endless batch of fresh, comforting holiday treats.
010.motto: The greatest gift you can bring to any room is a warm welcome.
010.nfcMotif: A steaming mug of spiced cider with a cinnamon-stick accent.

011.name: The Workshop Elf
011.title: The Master Toymaker
011.abilities: Crafts toys with lightning speed using magical paintbrushes and ringing jester-boot bells.
011.motto: Craft your days with passion, and put a little play into everything you make!
011.nfcMotif: A brass gear framed by crossed craft hammers.

012.name: The Cozy Polar Bear
012.title: The Gentle Giant
012.abilities: Provides grounding calm and cradles a tiny, protective paper lantern against cold winter winds.
012.motto: Stay soft in a cold world, and let your inner light lead the way.
012.nfcMotif: An embossed bear paw print with expanding radio ripples.

013.name: The Holiday Penguin
013.title: The Arctic Glider
013.abilities: Navigates tricky obstacles with effortless agility, kicking up crystalline ice shavings on silver skates.
013.motto: Glide through the bumps, find your rhythm, and enjoy the slide!
013.nfcMotif: A stylized ice-skate blade emblem encircled by radar rings.

014.name: The Sugar Plum Fairy
014.title: The Dream Weaver
014.abilities: Hovers mid-air, casting quiet enchantment and sparkling sugar crystals with a starlight wand.
014.motto: Believe in the quiet magic that dances just beyond what eyes can see.

015.name: The Abominable Yeti
015.title: The Gentle Snow Monster
015.abilities: Converts awkward moments into pure laughter while playfully tangling in colorful holiday lights.
015.motto: Big hearts make the best kind of holiday magic.
015.nfcMotif: A vintage teardrop holiday lightbulb with radial glow lines.

016.name: The Stocking Pup
016.title: The Hearth Companion
016.abilities: Delivers unconditional love and boundless joy straight from the fireplace mantle.
016.motto: Unconditional love, boundless joy, and the best kind of holiday warmth.
016.nfcMotif: A golden holiday dog bone badge.
